body:
Hi Rodney,

I spent some time on triplearoofmasters.com this week. Your story is the strongest part of the business, 43 years roofing, veteran owned, still passionate about it. But the homepage does not do it justice. The big headline misspells Experience as "Experintenance", the services are one short list with no detail, and there is no reviews section and no way to book anything except a Gmail address in plain text. A homeowner comparing roofers will move on before they ever learn who you are.

So I rebuilt your homepage, and it is attached to this email as a PDF. Your services are laid out clearly, your story and the 43 years sit up front, free estimates within 30 miles get their own section, and your phone number is one tap away.

Roofing sites are a big part of my work. I built leal-roofing.com for a roofing company that leads with inspections and repairs. I also built severeweatherroofing.com for storm damage calls, where speed matters most.

If you like it, I can put it on your real domain and build out the rest of the site. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no hard feelings.

Best,
Hassan
name: AAA Roof Masters METAL ROOFING
subject: 🏠 Your homepage spells it 'Experintenance'
